title: San okafwr jwngblaonai jwng
lyrics:
Ch,

San-okafwr jwngblaonai jwng
Daosen-daol abirbainai jwng -2
Jwn gboibw rongja khangdwng(dinwi)
Jwng boibw mwsa glangdwng
Onnain ibari bibar bari
Iswr Afani bwrni jhwri -2

(A)

Gaswi jengnafwrkhou barbw nanwi
Jiuni gatwnao jwng sofwinanwi-2
Dhwrwm sibinayao udang jabai
Gwthangni bijabao lerkha jabai

(B) 

Dhwrmao jebla jwng harsing jayw
Gothaibari Circle gojob fwiyw -2
Onkhangnanw ijwngkhou gonaithiyw
Rupathi be sana geolang jayw

(C) 

Gwsw mwdwm jiujwng sibigw njwng
Sabsin hamsin janw najagwn jwng -2
Jwngni onjlainaya jwngni bwlw
Jwngni phwthainaya jwngni gwhw
